texts.about_this_item: Monge VetSolution Gastrointestinal Feline is a complete dietetic feed for cats formulated to reduce intestinal absorptive disorders. Contains melon juice concentrate to neutralize free radicals, horse chestnut for intestinal support, and Xylo-oligosaccharides (XOS) to secure the intestinal microbiota. Highly digestible feed with increased sodium and potassium.
texts.ingredient_information: Dried pork meat (28%), tapioca, potatoes, hydrolysed salmon protein, animal fat (chicken oil), animal fat (tallow), pea fibre, fish oil (salmon oil), dried peas, dried fish (Anchovy 4%), minerals, Xylo-Oligosaccharide (XOS 0.4%), pineapple, dried horse chestnut (0.01%), products and by-products from processing fresh fruits and vegetables (melon juice concentrate), milk protein powder.
texts.feeding_instructions: It is recommended that a veterinarian's opinion be sought before use. Recommended length of time for use: up to 12 weeks. Recommended daily feeding intakes in grams to be fed in two meals. Fresh and clean water should be available at all times.
